name: VVLW
source:
This is a short game about a manor at the edge of town rumored to have a certain terrifying occupant and a certain lesbian deciding that said occupant is the perfect person to date.

[From [url=https://chezforshire.itch.io/vvlw]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这部短篇游戏讲述了镇子边缘的一座庄园：据说，那里住着某位可怕的家伙，而一名女同性恋者却认定，这位住户正是最理想的约会对象。

（摘自[url=https://chezforshire.itch.io/vvlw]itch.io[/url]）
